title: Zesty Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A peppery, juicy stew with a touch of vanilla braised to perfection for a savory brunch.
instructions: Heat a Dutch oven over medium heat and brown the beef cubes in batches, about 5 minutes per side, then set aside.
Add a splash of oil to the pot and sauté the diced onion until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the beef to the pot, then add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, stirring to coat.
Pour in the red wine, scraping the bottom of the pot to deglaze, and let it reduce by half, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, beef broth, thyme, bay leaf, pepper, and vanilla extract, bringing the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and braise for 60 minutes, turning occasionally until the beef is fork‑tender.
Remove the bay leaf, taste the stew, and adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Serve the stew hot in bowls, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Pair with crusty rye bread for a complete Norwegian brunch.
